note: Human visual review of the starter-skin knight (2026-10-01), kept beside the project and merged by scripts/build-2d-knight.mjs. Evidence: validation/qa/<clip>.png (contact sheets) and validation/qa/compare-*.png (3D vs 2D at the same times). Exceptions are only recorded where those images were checked.

exceptions.reason: arm swings out with the wrist seen edge-on: the narrower silhouette leaves part of the 10 px probe empty, but the cuff and open hand are joined (compare-salute-hand.png 0 s)
same as the start of the clip on the way back (compare-salute-hand.png 3.8 s)
hands/guard/forearms change depth together as the grip rotates through the wind-up and strike; layering matches the 3D render (compare-slash-order.png 0.367/0.4/0.867/0.9 s)
return to guard; layering matches the 3D render (compare-order.png 1.867/1.9 s)
the blade points toward the camera in the follow-through; the 3D view is equally short (compare-slash.png 1.7 s)
raised arm moves in front of the chest; matches 3D (compare-order.png 0.533/0.567 s)
arm returns beside the body; matches 3D (compare-order.png 3.9 s)
authored demo: the clip keys the right fingers behind the palm at 2.0 s and back at 2.8 s (finger_tests_2d shows keyed layer order)

idle.note: reads correctly; starter (3D-captured) art except the painted helmet in the painted skin

hover_sword_vigil.note: both palms on the sword the whole loop (contact art 100%), hover forearm captures match 3D

sword_2h_idle.note: guard pose: pose-specific pauldrons/vambraces, both grips on the hilt (contact art 100%)

sword_2h_slash.note: wind-up/strike/guard captures match 3D; depth swaps verified; blade very short at 1.77-1.83 s exactly as in 3D

knight_salute.note: open palm → fist on chest → open palm tracks 3D. Mid-raise (0.33-0.6 s, 3.3-3.53 s) uses a forearm-toward-camera capture (cuff ring under the open hand, as in 3D); pose captures no longer stretch with foreshortening. walk_in_place.note: regression clip: swing captures fix the crumpled hands; no open flags

finger_tests_2d.note: curls now shorten toward the palm with denser finger meshes and wider knuckle blends: worst fold 3.3% (pinky, deepest curl) down from 9.1%; flags remain above the 2% threshold at full curls

contact_detonator_2d.note: thumb drawn in front of the remote and visibly presses the button (contact art 100%); thumb fold 2.85% at the knuckle while bent (was 9.45%)
